dct_description_sm: This qualitative data set was generated as part of a Master of Arts thesis chapter. The objectives of this project were to: - Understand the environmental and economic legacies of mining at Nanisivik; - Document the closure and reclamation activities at Nanisivik to analyse how these impacts were dealt with;  - Better theorize Arctic resource development projects and their legacies.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Resource development
dct_title_s: Documents related to the Closure and Reclamation of the Nanisivik Mine
